newsitem.title: USA: Sears, Roebuck and Co Q4 net, revenues rise.
newsitem.headline: Sears, Roebuck and Co Q4 net, revenues rise.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
12 MONTHS
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1995 year net includes gain of $776 million, or $1.97 a share, from net income from former subsidiary Allstate Corp, which was spun off to Sears shareholders in June 1995.
1996 Q4 net income from domestic operations $531 million vs $463 million.
1996 Q4 revs from domestic operations $10.92 billion vs $9.79 billion.
1996 Q4 domestic comparable-store sales rose 5.4 percent from a year earlier.
1996 year net income from domestic operations $1.28 billion vs $1.06 billion.
1996 revs from domestic operations $34.85 billion vs $31.63 billion.
1996 Q4 income from international operations $36 million vs loss $7 million, and for year loss $5 million vs loss $30 million.
Restructuring at Sears Canada in 1996 reduced Sears income by $10 million in 1996.
((-- Chicago Newsdesk 312 408 8787))
